{{Conjecture|legends}}
An individual was the '''first''' to hold the title of [[Grand Protector/Legends|Grand Protector]],<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Archaeology|The First Protector}}</ref> leader of the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Species/Legends|species']] civilization on<ref name="Essential Guide">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]].<ref name="Essential Guide" /> By [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|3.0}} As the Crew Skill mission "The First Protector" was released with the ''Shadow of Revan'' expansion, it must therefore take place around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] as well.</ref> rumors surfaced that a [[First Grand Protector's ceremonial blaster|ceremonial blaster]] which belonged to the First Grand Protector was buried somewhere on the floor of Rodia's [[Wesessa Sea/Legends|Wesessa Sea]].<ref name="Mission" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
By that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> an individual affiliated with one of the factions in the then-ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion of theirs to recover the ceremonial [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="Mission" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The first Grand Protector was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "The First Protector," released as part of the [[2014]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']] expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Mission" />
